summary.headline: Palchus Chapter Index
summary.text: Index of chapters in Palchus’s astrological book, covering zodiac signs and seasons, weather changes, horary questions, lots of fortune, term rulers, births, letters, stars, courts, and lost objects according to Erasistratus. The entries give manuscript folio references and include a cross-reference to codex Angelicus 29.
